entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The rally Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/rally*, with its static game and the D1 database rally-scores.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/rally/ and its public scores page.
entities.deployedBy: By hand: the owner, or an agent the owner asks, runs `npm run deploy` in games/rally (npm test, npm run build, wrangler deploy) with a Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account. Nothing deploys on a merge to main; the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
The owner's say-so: only the owner, or an agent the owner asks, deploys.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out an earlier commit and deploy it again by hand with `npm run deploy`. A database migration is not undone by this; migrations are written so the previous code keeps working (docs/database-migrations.md).
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. Its migrations delete the Durable Object class Room, which held online rooms before they moved to the games hub; both migration entries stay, because Cloudflare applies them in order.
